title: Document Reload And Restoration

specification.title: Document Reload And Restoration
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Save/load native document đầy đủ geometry/history/layer/gem instance; xuất STL watertight và báo lỗi hình học.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không xây thêm 3DM reader trong codec native; không làm STEP/IGES ở giai đoạn này.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Document Reload And Restoration” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: save/reload or import transaction preserves object IDs, units, layer assignments and declared metadata.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.title: Document Reload And Restoration
execution_design.positive_oracle_proposed: Open saved project restores IDs/layers/instances and active document state
execution_design.negative_oracle_proposed: Failed load leaves current unsaved document untouched
execution_design.reuse_approval_condition: Audit local checkout at pinned SHA, compile/tests, M00 human legal approval; do not infer ready from static GitHub read.
execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

trimmed_boolean_v6_save_open_2026_11_18.scope: The existing Save As and Open lifecycle now round-trips a single-body trimmed Boolean Difference result after its worker retains the already-captured topology attestation. The v6 archive restores the source identity and supports Surface Snap to the same face.
trimmed_boolean_v6_save_open_2026_11_18.remaining: The v5 batch encoder still refuses BRep. Other BRep producers and desktop workflow require their own coverage.

native_history_worker_routing_2026_11_18.scope: Native history display rebuild passes the shared history cancellation flag to the packaged native display worker when its fingerprint is embedded; both cargo check configurations passed.
native_history_worker_routing_2026_11_18.remaining: Undo/Redo cache-miss and cancellation during a native call need runtime coverage. Builds without the fingerprint keep the in-process path, and opaque NativeBrep archive persistence remains unsupported.

native_payload_async_open_2026_11_18.scope: With a packaged native worker fingerprint, asynchronous legacy v4 Open rebuilds a missing native display in the contained worker, retaining source identity and transferring the accounted display before scene publication. One generated Box fixture passed Controller Open.
native_payload_async_open_2026_11_18.remaining: Opaque NativeBrep archive save and Job Bag persistence remain unsupported; history remeshing and builds without the fingerprint retain the existing in-process path. Other payloads, cancellation during native work, paired production build and desktop remain unverified.

native_payload_display_worker_2026_11_18.scope: A pinned, process-limited native 3DM payload display worker and Rust host passed focused payload identity, stale context, cancellation, rejection and scene adoption tests.
native_payload_display_worker_2026_11_18.remaining: Legacy Open and Job Bag are not connected to this worker; opaque NativeBrep archive roundtrip, paired production build and desktop behavior remain open. Native allocator safety is not certified by process containment.

creation_order_v5_reload_2026_11_19.scope: The v5 archive writes creation order through the existing entity extension envelope. The earlier Windows build opened and saved the updated archive. The newer build reopened it with all seven source identities, geometry, and creation stamps preserved.

brep_reopen_resave_2026_11_18.scope: Normal v6 Open retains the accounted verified input. Subsequent Save selects current source packets, combines newly attested sources, and omits deleted sources. A headless Box fixture passed save/open, edits and multiple resaves including an added and removed BRep.
brep_reopen_resave_2026_11_18.remaining: The entire original archive stays cached until replacement, and newly saved sources require current proofs until reopening. NativeBrep, Job Bag, native capture containment, actual paired build and desktop remain open; v5 guard remains.

brep_controller_async_save_2026_11_18.scope: Normal Controller Save stages v6 on a worker when all sources have current topology proofs and a worker fingerprint is embedded. A command-created Box passed Save As, overwrite, Open, cancel and stale Undo headlessly; 20 existing file lifecycle checks passed.
brep_controller_async_save_2026_11_18.remaining: Proofs for reopened documents are not retained, so another BRep Save may refuse. Missing proofs, NativeBrep, Job Bag integration, native containment, production paired build and desktop acceptance remain open; v5 guard remains.

brep_staged_publication_context_2026_11_.scope: Verified v6 staging returns a locked file whose publication checks the coordinator context and cancellation. A background peer completed after an intervening edit; stale publication was refused and the destination remained unchanged.
brep_staged_publication_context_2026_11_.remaining: The caller must supply the original coordinator and separately validate file/project operation state. Controller proof discovery, normal Save/Job Bag, reopened proofs, native containment and desktop remain open. Deferred v6 staging currently requires Windows; v5 guard remains.

brep_attested_capture_save_2026_11_18.scope: Experimental capture-and-save converts current account-owned attested topology sources into packets and verifies coverage. A box reused by a root, translated block definition and result round-tripped with one packet; cancellation and stale proof preserved the destination.
brep_attested_capture_save_2026_11_18.remaining: Callers must supply proofs and run capture off the UI thread. Proof discovery for every source and reopened documents, native containment, normal Save/Job Bag and desktop remain open; OCCT calls are not bounded or interruptible by Rust admission; v5 guard remains.

brep_verified_v6_staging_2026_11_18.scope: An experimental writer accepts admitted v6 source/ShapeSet packets, verifies native restoration before staging and from staging readback, then atomically replaces the target. The two-box fixture exercised success, cancellation, absent packet and mismatched native source.
brep_verified_v6_staging_2026_11_18.remaining: The writer does not capture packets or connect normal Save or Job Bag. Native topology proof, DLL authentication, production packaging, full codec acceptance and desktop remain open; v5 guard remains.

archive_truncation_refusal_2026_11_18.scope: Archive reads reject truncation after the initial size measurement; the integration fixture confirms the admission guard is released. Growth refusal also passed.
archive_truncation_refusal_2026_11_18.remaining: Same-length concurrent changes are not detected. The full archive suite still has a project_codec_acceptance compile failure against CanonicalBrep; BRep round-trip and desktop acceptance remain open.

brep_normal_open_2026_11_18.scope: Experimental v6 BRep enters the normal Open worker in builds with a pinned sibling worker; a two-box archive with a translated block and resource opened, while corrupt input preserved the prior scene and document.
brep_normal_open_2026_11_18.remaining: Production paired build and desktop validation were not run. Save, Job Bag, source capture, native DLL authentication, exact topology proof and decoder bounds remain open; v5 guard remains.

brep_worker_image_fingerprint_2026_11_17.scope: The app has an explicit packaged-worker admission path using a build-embedded SHA-256 and a sibling executable; a Windows build helper builds the worker first and embeds its digest while reusing an existing external target. A fixture accepted the matching worker and refused missing, malformed and mismatched fingerprints.
brep_worker_image_fingerprint_2026_11_17.remaining: The paired app/worker build was not run because OM9 is open. Native dependency DLLs are not authenticated, the worker is not a sandbox, and ordinary Open/Save and Job Bag are not connected. Source capture, topology proof and desktop acceptance remain open; v5 guard remains.

brep_bound_controller_replacement_2026_1.scope: A private bound v6 candidate can pass document restoration, shared-account representation setup, scene construction and atomic Controller replacement. A two-box fixture retained a block instance placement, result and resource after the old Controller was dropped; cancellation and stale context preserved the old state.
brep_bound_controller_replacement_2026_1.remaining: Only the integration fixture calls this path; normal Open/Save and Job Bag do not. File lifecycle, capture for all BRep owners, trusted worker packaging, exact native topology attestation, broader budgets and desktop acceptance remain open; v5 guard remains.

brep_replacement_representation_sharing_.scope: A private replacement coordinator sharing the existing memory account can reuse its validated account-owned BRep representation store. A two-source fixture built a replacement scene with a block instance after releasing the detached staging owner; a foreign account and cancellation were refused.
brep_replacement_representation_sharing_.remaining: No controller replacement is published and the old coordinator remained alive in the fixture. The caller must recheck operation context at publication. Trusted worker packaging, topology proof, source capture, ordinary Open/Save, Job Bag and desktop acceptance remain open; the v5 guard remains.

brep_document_detached_scene_2026_11_17.scope: A bound v6 candidate can build an admitted detached scene using the restoring coordinator's representations. A fixture checked pick geometry for two BRep roots and a block instance while the existing document and epoch stayed unchanged.
brep_document_detached_scene_2026_11_17.remaining: The scene and document are not published or transferred into a replacement coordinator. Trusted worker packaging, native topology proof, source capture for all owners, ordinary Open/Save, Job Bag and desktop acceptance remain open; the v5 guard remains.

brep_document_source_binding_2026_11_17.scope: A detached v6 document can bind registered restored BRep sources into all root, definition-member and published-result occurrences while retaining source and document reservations. An authored fixture checked shared versus distinct source identities, representation availability and an embedded resource payload.
brep_document_source_binding_2026_11_17.remaining: The bound document is not yet transferred into a replacement controller or published scene. Trusted worker packaging, durable native topology attestation, capture coverage, ordinary Open/Save, Job Bag and desktop acceptance remain open; the v5 guard remains.

brep_document_worker_restore_2026_11_17.scope: The private host decodes an experimental v6 candidate, admits each packet, checks complete portable association and restores all unique sources through the contained worker while retaining document, vector and candidate reservations. brep_document_worker_restore_2026_11_17.remaining: This returns detached candidates, not a published document. Normal Open/Save, Job Bag integration, trusted worker packaging, source capture for all owners, native topology proof, geometry-occurrence mapping, typed decoder bounds and desktop acceptance remain open. brep_document_candidate_v6_2026_11_17.scope: An explicit experimental v6 document candidate stores canonical metadata and checked source/ShapeSet chunks, checks packet coverage across roots, definitions and results on encode, and offers structural decode plus separately reserved packet association validation. brep_document_candidate_v6_2026_11_17.remaining: This is not wired to ordinary Open, Save or Job Bags. hardening_notes:
# OM9-L3-01-12-007 — Hardened L3/L4 design (v0.15)

**Đây là hợp đồng thiết kế đề xuất; không phải chữ ký API đã tồn tại trong QymCAD.** Chỉ implement khi M00 PASS và QymCAD fork được phép. Đọc source tại SHA `746a17f127897e921a57118b6caad08968602bf5`.

## Ranh giới module
- Owner: `OM9-L2-01-12`.
- Luồng/đối tượng: project scene restoration.
- Mã QymCAD cần đọc và xác minh function thực tế: `crates/qymcad-io/src/project_file.rs`.
- API Rust dự kiến: `App::open_document(path) -> Result<DocumentId, OpenError>`. Nếu API hiện tại khác, lập ADR nhỏ, không tự thêm bản sao module trùng lặp.

## Fixture đầu vào và oracle độc lập
- **Positive:** reopen matches stable IDs and mass properties.
- **Negative:** failed read keeps currently opened document untouched.
- Đóng băng `positive.json`, `negative.json` *trước khi sửa mã*. Bắt buộc có `observed.json` do runtime tạo, không tự sao `expected` thành `actual`.
- Đối chiếu các assert `exact/near/error_code` theo `tools/m01_proof.py`, viết báo cáo `om9.m01.oracle.v1.5` gắn vào command receipt.

## Việc cho từng L4
1. `-01` SOURCE_AUDIT: tra source pin, tìm symbol với `rg`, lập bảng method→owner→khả năng REUSE/ADAPT/ADD; không báo build thành công.
2. `-02` CONTRACT_TEST: chốt API và 2 fixture; chạy fixture-validation exit 0, lập test tích hợp RED có chủ đích.
3. `-03` IMPLEMENT: thay đổi tại owner, chạy focused Rust tests + negative regression rồi ghi oracle từ run thật.
4. `-04` INTEGRATE (nếu có): kiểm tra liên module và rollback/identity/viewport; không dùng mock thay kernel.
5. `-05` ACCEPTANCE: chạy regression, kiểm thử môi trường Windows nếu GUI; đối chiếu reviewer độc lập.

## Dừng khi không rõ
- Không tìm thấy API/hàm theo pin: `BLOCKED_SOURCE` và báo đường dẫn đã đọc.
- Không tạo được runtime fixture/thiếu OCCT hoặc GPU: `BLOCKED_ENV`/`BLOCKED_FIXTURE`.
- Kết quả không đạt oracle: `FAIL` và giữ log; không tự ghi PASS.

sdk_export_plan.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
